method: Read-only independently recomputed source/observer/constructor hashes, prior independent geometry cold-read identity, original driver/guard source inspection, native raw log and physical-record review. No QA Godot invocation.
verdict: Original Main Clyde return passes its source-bound six checks under researched private 60mm/12mm/10mm native geometry. Exact controller remains unchanged. This is bounded regression evidence for D014, not complete contact, art or coping integration acceptance.
limits: 472 camera samples run after initial 30 presentation warmup frames. They are completed process/presentation samples, not every-physics sampling. Existing exact frustum/ray/native camera-volume authority was retained.

Camera rays to real board convex vertices and sole/toe/head markers rejected the earlier penetration. A camera pass alone does not independently establish every triangle, actual loaded-wheel count or whole-model floor contact at every tick.

Active authored transition snapshot is proven; active cylindrical transition branch is not exercised in this run.

Trace global transforms/velocities are Godot strings. They preserve observed native rows but not full-precision numeric transforms, and geometry intentionally changes physical trajectory; no old trajectory parity is asserted.
790 recorded source inputs exclude imported cache and the observer; its separate receipt SHA binds the archived observer. Broader corpus adds 11 documents/export inputs.
Original receipt records command/exit and aggregate duration but lacks native PID/individual absolute process start/end timestamps. No process-exclusivity or CPU/M5 cost claim follows.
Full Quarter/Bowl/Sunken/halfpipe/spine/grind/lip/transfer/route/career combined regression and normal-speed visible profile/contact review remain open.
